requirements.observations: All elevation and isometric views show one centered, upright beacon: a chamfered circular base supports a smooth tapered tower and spherical cap. Both attachment transitions are continuous, the opposing silhouettes agree, and there are no unintended holes, fragments, merged features, or clipping.

views.observations: Centered spherical cap, smooth tapered tower, and chamfered base form a clean continuous silhouette.
Rear elevation matches the front and confirms both attachment joints without gaps or stray geometry.
Left elevation preserves the intended radial profile, grounded base, taper, and centered cap.
Right elevation matches the left with no asymmetry, clipping, or missing features.
Concentric base, tower, and spherical cap are visible; the circular stack is centered and complete.
Bottom view shows one uninterrupted circular base face with no holes or disconnected material.
Chamfer, rounded tapered tower transitions, spherical cap, and overlapping connected joints are clearly resolved.
Opposing isometric confirms the same centered continuous BOSL2 stack and clean rear surfaces.
